follow-up time: weekly until S. aureus acquisition and 7 days after
outcome: predicted abundance of genes contributing to antimicrobial compound synthesis
cohort: 15 hospitalized neonates, 8 cases who acquired S. aureus colonization and 7 matched controls
finding: Neonates without S. aureus colonization had a higher abundance of bacterial species that may antagonize S. aureus, suggesting potential for developing novel infection prevention strategies.
